03 / NOW / SEPTEMBER 2026

Mostly Unity.
Still curious.

A small snapshot of what has my attention.

BUILDING

Gameplay, one system at a time.

Working with Unity and C#, with an interest in player movement, gameplay behaviour, and interactive controllers. The RFID platformer is one ongoing project.

LEARNING

More of the machinery underneath.

Computer science, systems, and the programming behind games. Unreal and C++ are directions I want to explore further as I improve.

EXPERIMENTING

Different ways to interact.

VR, game mechanics, and the boundary between a physical controller and what happens on screen. Also, giving small web experiments somewhere to live.

ON THE HORIZON

Making games professionally.

Game development is the direction I’m working towards. Longer term, I’m also interested in opportunities at studios in Japan.

A dated snapshot, not a live status indicator.
